title: What lies between polynomial and exponential growth?
summary: In this paper we give an alternative exposition of a recent paper regarding the classification of growth rates of real functions. We take a different point of view, focussing on understanding possible growth rates between polynomial and exponential. In order to be able to explicitly name a range of such functions, we first need to extend our basic functions. We do this via a 'tower' of Abel functions.
